tasks.title: Multiple partial refunds can exceed the captured amount
tasks.summary: Fixed PAY-4420 by comparing refund amounts against the payment's remaining refundable amount (`p.Remaining().Minor`) rather than the initial total amount (`p.Amount.Minor`) in `payment.Service.Refund`. Attempted refunds that exceed the remaining amount are now rejected with ErrRefundExceedsRemaining (422 refund_exceeds_remaining), leaving the payment unchanged. Refunding exactly the remaining amount continues to transition the payment to REFUNDED. Added unit and API integration tests covering partial refunds, rejected over-refunds, state retention, and full refunds.

tasks.title: Add payment cancellation (CANCELED status + endpoint + webhook)
Identical retries rejected as idempotency key reuse
tasks.summary: Fixed mobile SDK retries being rejected with 422 idempotency_key_reused. Body fingerprinting now canonicalizes JSON payloads by normalizing key order, whitespace, currency case (uppercase), and decimal amounts (trimming redundant fractional and leading zeros). Retries with rebuilt JSON for payments and refunds now produce matching semantic fingerprints and successfully replay the original response.
